throughput.note: Capture too small to measure throughput: 109 packets, fewer than the 10,000 needed for a stable rate. Run `cipherguard bench` for a reproducible figure.

assumptions.note: The CRQC arrival estimate is a planning assumption, not a prediction. Substitute the agency's own figure; the ranking of links is unchanged by it, only the urgency framing.

provenance.report_digest_covers: SHA-256 over the sorted rule-ID:subject pair of every finding, first 16 hex digits. Two reports with the same digest raised the same findings on the same links.
